comment: A land mine under a boulder: the hero arms a wished land mine on the square where a wished boulder fell, polymorphs into a hill giant, steps off and back on (the boulder cannot move into the wall beyond, so the giant maneuvers over it) and sets the mine off. trap.c blow_up_landmine() -> explode.c scatter() extracts the boulder with obj_extract_self() -> mkobj.c remove_object(), which calls vision.c recalc_block_point() for the boulder, then fractures it.
